title: Consumer Protection on Kickstarter
authors: Daniel Blaseg; Christian Schulze; Bernd Skiera
eligible_reason: Cross-sectional campaign-level analysis with propensity-score matching (psmatch2) and a triple difference around one common policy date (Kickstarter's 'Kickstarter is not a store' policy change): reg outcome treatment_time##treatment_effect##pac monthyear on PSM-matched samples (Table 17); no unit FE, single adoption date, matching-based. The README states the variables are synthesized.
